notes: Coordinates are verified approach points or gate tiles; vendors can wander nearby.
Prices and stock are observations from 2026-10-01, not guaranteed current quotes.
These places are also registered in the clients existing places.json for uo place find/go.
Portal tiles require manual final movement and sometimes double-clicking; ordinary routes avoid them.

places.name: Abrah reagent shop
places.notes: Buy ginseng, garlic, mandrake root and nightshade (3 gold each), or blood moss (5 gold). Abrah the herbalist, serial 655; say Abrah buy. Bulk stock verified 2026-10-01. NPC wanders nearby.

places.name: Ariana reagent shop
places.notes: Ethereal Goods. Buy spiders silk, sulfurous ash, garlic and mandrake root (3 gold each), or black pearls (5 gold). Ariana the alchemist, serial 415409; say Ariana buy. Ginseng stock was limited. NPC wanders nearby.

places.name: Barrett reagent shop
places.notes: Ethereal Goods. Bulk garlic and mandrake root (3 gold each). Barrett the herbalist, serial 415411; say Barrett buy. Ginseng stock was limited. NPC wanders nearby.

places.name: Fleta mage shop
places.notes: Buy black pearls (5 gold), ginseng, spiders silk and sulfurous ash (3 gold), and spell scrolls. Fleta the mage, serial 416915; say Fleta buy. Garlic and mandrake stock was only 40 each; prefer Abrah for those.

places.name: Quiet Britain training
places.notes: Quiet spot verified with no nearby mobiles and full HP during Greater Heal self-training. Check current surroundings before each session. Greater Heal uses garlic, ginseng, mandrake root and spiders silk; preserve black pearls for hunting.

places.name: New Haven mine waiting point
places.notes: Outside the New Haven Mine entrance. Moving west to tile 3508,2777 triggers the mine teleporter; the first movement request may only turn. Hunt only while the user is present, and avoid paragon elementals.

places.name: Mine exit to New Haven bank
places.notes: Gate named Back to New Haven Bank, serial 1079701476. Walk within 1 tile, manually step onto it, then double-click. Arrival is bank roof 3482,2570,48. Routes avoid portal tiles.

places.name: New Haven roof gate to Britain
places.notes: Britain Bank gate, serial 1529031526, on the New Haven bank roof. Stand on it and double-click. Arrival is 1382,1714,20 in Britain. Routes avoid portal tiles.

places.name: Britain arrival from New Haven
places.notes: Verified arrival from the Britain Bank gate on New Haven bank roof. Abrah reagent shop is nearby at 1411,1714.

places.name: Britain public moongate
places.notes: PublicGate, serial 1073844579. Stand on it and use it; identify the menu by title Public Moongate, never by fixed gump id. GO button 1, switch 200 = New Haven, 201 = Britain. New Haven arrival is the bank roof around 3483,2569,48.

places.name: Britain corpse summoner
places.notes: Saxon the corpse summoner, serial 2209, observed nearby at 1416,1717,20. This is the resurrection area. If dead, inspect existing gumps before using ghostprompt because it toggles the death menu.

places.name: Hanging Mace Sanctuary arrival
places.notes: Verified public moongate arrival from Britain; resync may correct ground z to 6. Choose Noteworthy Establishments (button 107), Hanging Mace Sanctuary (switch 204), GO (button 1). New-player LRC quest NPCs are on the roof at z46, but the roof teleporter blocks Young characters. NPC speech worked from the ground. To leave, stand at 2133,3114/3115 under the crystal portal and say Vesper Mint; this arrives in Trammel at 2899,676,0. Keep Young status.

places.name: Vesper crystal portal arrival
places.notes: Crystal Portal command Vesper Mint arrives here. Vesper Travel Agent is nearby; public city moongate north at 2901,660.

places.name: Vesper city moongate
places.notes: Verified gate serial 1201245462. Stand on tile and double-click. Noteworthy Establishments tab (107), Hanging Mace Sanctuary switch204, GO1.

places.name: Magincia magical stone exchange
places.notes: Public moongate Special Locations (button106), Magical Stone Exchange switch201, GO1. Verified arrival 3675,2115,25. Nearby New Player Stone and specialist exchange stones; inspect each price and currency before buying.

places.name: Magincia exchange public gate
places.notes: Verified public gate serial1074228497 beside the stone exchange. Public Moongate menu supports Noteworthy Establishments to Hanging Mace Sanctuary.

places.name: Britain trade minister
places.notes: Verified Atlas arrival beside Allan the minister of trade (serial482), 1436,1760,-2. Donation crate serial1073775665 at1436,1759,-2 accepts raw fish/ribs and common resources. Food vendors on this dock.

places.name: Britain city bulletin board
places.notes: Verified approach point beside board serial1073746062 at1481,1718,0, graphic0xa0c5. Citizenship may be required to read city messages. Do not include quest answers in saved location notes.

places.name: Community Center arrival
places.notes: Public moongate Special Locations (106), Community Center switch200, GO1. Public rune library and repair benches; inspect supplies and training facilities here.

places.name: Community Center repair benches
places.notes: Repair benches verified at575,1330,2 (west) and589,1330,2 (east), with signs above them. These support equipment repairs and the final Hanging Mace quest step. Custom floor geometry may require manual movement; keep quest answers out of location notes.

places.name: Vesper bank
places.notes: Fawne the banker, serial 418996. Bank and cash withdrawals verified this visit.
